mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, event_title, community_id, event_id, actor_user_id) SELECT a.user_id, 'event_deleted', e.title, e.community_id, NULL, NULL FROM events e JOIN applications a ON a.event_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{eventId} AND a.status <> 'rejected' AND a.user_id <> #{operatorUserId}
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, event_title, community_id, event_id, actor_user_id) SELECT #{userId}, #{type}, e.title, e.community_id, e.id, NULL FROM events e WHERE e.id = #{eventId}
mapper.sql: SELECT n.id, n.type, n.event_title, n.community_id, n.event_id, n.actor_user_id, u.nickname AS actor_nickname, n.read_at, n.created_at FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = n.actor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, now()) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
UPDATE notifications SET read_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
